name: Crossroads High
difficulty_label: Hard — three department bosses and four possible Final Exams
description: An enchanted campus of teal lockers, trophy-lined halls and busy classrooms. Explore the copper-pot Foods kitchen, plum-curtained Black Box theatre, maple-floored Iron Hall and welcoming student commons. Defeat the three department guardians, take the stairs to the science and humanities wing, and face one random Final Exam: fire Mathematics, ghostly wind English, slowing ice History or poisonous Science. Each retains four distinct attacks.
